name: MoYu AoLong 3x3 V5 AI (Magnetic) - Bluetooth Smart Cube
description: The MoYu AoLong 3x3 V5 AI (Magnetic) - Bluetooth Smart Cube is a 48-magnet AoLong V5 that talks to your phone. Connect it to the WCU CUBE app to time solves, train with an AI coach, and race cubers around the world, then go about 300 hours before it needs another charge.
features: An AI coach that keeps up: Real-time coaching flags mistakes as you practice, and post-solve analysis reports show your strengths and weaknesses at a glance.
Someone to race at any hour: Take on cubers 1v1, build or join a club team, or play ranked matches online.
Long time between charges: About 300 hours of use per charge in MoYu's lab testing, and the included dock charges the cube when you set it down.
Matte finish: A refined matte surface with a familiar, medium-grip feel.
Digital Dual Adjustment System: Elasticity and tension adjust independently for fast, precise changes to the turning feel.
8 elasticity levels: Go from soft to firm in eight steps.
